# GeoChain — Complete Documentation

> A free online geography game where you chain countries together by borders, continents, and letter patterns.

Website: https://www.geo-chain.com
Creator: https://x.com/veluthoor

## Overview

GeoChain is an educational geography game that challenges players to build the longest chain of countries possible in 2 minutes. Each country in the chain must satisfy a rule connecting it to the previous country — such as sharing a border, being on the same continent, or starting with a specific letter.

The game is completely free, requires no sign-up, and works on any modern browser (desktop and mobile).

## Gameplay

1. The player enters their name (optional, used for leaderboard)
2. They choose a difficulty level: Easy or Hard
3. A random starting country is selected
4. A challenge rule is presented (e.g., "Name a country that borders Japan")
5. The player types a country name and submits
6. If correct: the country is added to the chain, score increases, a new rule appears
7. If wrong: feedback is shown with a hint
8. The game ends when the 2-minute timer expires or no valid moves remain
9. The result screen shows: score, chain length, possible answers for the last challenge, and leaderboard placement

## Difficulty Levels

### Easy
- Rule types: borders, same continent, starts with same letter, starts with last letter
- Score multiplier: 1x

### Hard (Recommended for geography enthusiasts)
- Rule types: all Easy rules + capital letter match
- Score multiplier: 2x

## Scoring

- Base points per correct answer: 100
- Streak bonus: +25 per consecutive correct answer (max +200)
- Difficulty multiplier applied on top
- Leaderboard tracks top 20 scores per difficulty

## Rule Types Explained

### Borders
"Name a country that borders [country]"
The answer must share a land border with the current country. Island nations with no land borders will never get this rule.

### Same Continent
"Name a country in [continent]"
The answer must be on the same continent (Africa, Asia, Europe, North America, South America, or Oceania).

### Starts With Same Letter
"Name a country starting with [letter]"
The answer's name must begin with the same letter as the current country. Autocomplete is hidden for this rule to make it more challenging.

### Starts With Last Letter
"Name a country starting with [letter]"
The answer's name must begin with the last letter of the current country's name. Autocomplete is hidden for this rule.

### Capital Letter Match (Hard only)
"Name a country whose capital starts with [letter]"
The answer must have a capital city starting with the same letter as the current country's capital.

## Smart Features

### Fuzzy Name Matching
Players can type approximate country names. The game recognizes:
- Abbreviations: USA, UK, UAE, DRC
- Common names: America, Britain, Holland, Burma
- Historical names: Persia, Siam, Czechoslovakia
- Misspellings: Columbia → Colombia, Brasil → Brazil

### Dead-End Prevention
Before presenting a rule, the engine verifies at least one valid unused country exists. If no rule has a valid answer, the game ends gracefully with "No more moves!" instead of leaving the player stuck.

### Autocomplete
An autocomplete dropdown shows the top 5 matching countries as the player types. This is intentionally disabled for letter-based rules (starts with same/last letter) to make those challenges test recall.

## Data

- 197 countries with ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes
- Accurate land border adjacency data
- Country metadata: name, capital, continent, population, flag emoji, landlocked status
- ~100 alternate name mappings

## Technical Stack

- React + TypeScript + Vite (frontend only, no backend)
- Tailwind CSS for styling
- Framer Motion for animations
- Fuse.js for fuzzy search
- localStorage for stats and leaderboard persistence

## Comparisons to Other Geography Games

| Feature | GeoChain | GeoGuessr | Seterra | Sporcle Geography |
|---------|----------|-----------|---------|-------------------|
| Free | Yes | Freemium | Yes | Yes (with ads) |
| Unique mechanic | Country chaining | Street view guessing | Map clicking | Timed lists |
| Teaches borders | Yes | Indirectly | Yes | No |
| No sign-up needed | Yes | No | Yes | No |
| Mobile friendly | Yes | Yes | Yes | Partial |
| Timed challenge | 2 min | Varies | Optional | Yes |

## FAQ

Q: What is GeoChain?
A: GeoChain is a free online geography game where you chain countries together based on rules like shared borders, same continent, or letter patterns. Play at geo-chain.com.

Q: How do I play GeoChain?
A: Start with a random country, then type countries that satisfy each challenge rule. Build the longest chain in 2 minutes.

Q: Is GeoChain free?
A: Yes, completely free with no ads and no sign-up required.

Q: What makes GeoChain different from other geography games?
A: GeoChain's unique chaining mechanic means each answer depends on your previous one, creating a dynamic path across the globe. It tests broader geographic knowledge than simple map quizzes.

Q: Can I play on my phone?
A: Yes, GeoChain is fully responsive and works on mobile browsers.

Q: How is the leaderboard tracked?
A: Scores are saved locally in your browser per difficulty level (Easy and Hard), tracking the top 20 scores.

Q: Who made GeoChain?
A: GeoChain was made by @veluthoor. Feedback can be sent via X (Twitter) at https://x.com/veluthoor.
